public_findings.title: Finalis testnet-1: BFT finality and confidential transactions from genesis
public_findings.snippet: Finalis testnet-1: BFT finality and confidential transactions from genesis Announcing the first public testnet of Finalis. Finalis is a UTXO blockchain where blocks are final once a quorum of the validator committee signs them. There are no reorgs and no waiting for confirmations: a transaction in a finalized block cannot be reversed. Amounts can be hidden. A confidential output carries a Pedersen commitment instead of a value, with a range proof that it is not negative. Validators check that inputs and outputs balance without learning the amounts. public_findings.snippet: Background: Why Quantum Bitcoin (Q-BTC)? The physical qubit threshold required to break elliptic-curve cryptography (secp256k1) is dropping faster than anticipated. In legacy PoW networks, Shor's algorithm does not just threaten dormant addresses with exposed public keys; broadcasting a standard transaction exposes the public key in the mempool, turning the 10-minute confirmation window into a direct attack surface.
